note: Let x=BD/DC, y=CE/EA, z=AF/FB. Interior assumptions give x,y,z>0 and D=(b+xc)/(1+x), E=(ya+c)/(1+y), F=(a+zb)/(1+z). For barycentric coordinates (alpha,beta,gamma), line AD iff gamma=x beta, line BE iff alpha=y gamma, line CF iff beta=z alpha. Necessity follows by multiplying after excluding zero coordinates; sufficiency uses normalized coordinates (xy,1,x).
